## Laboratory metrics

| Metric | Mobile before | Mobile after | Desktop before | Desktop after |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| First Contentful Paint | 2.9 s | 1.5 s | 0.7 s | 0.3 s |
| Largest Contentful Paint | 5.9 s | 4.7 s | 0.9 s | 0.9 s |
| Total Blocking Time | 790 ms | 70 ms | 1,770 ms | 140 ms |
| Speed Index | 7.1 s | 1.8 s | 3.8 s | 1.0 s |
| Cumulative Layout Shift | 0.001 | 0.008 | 0.043 | 0.05 |
| Total network payload | 4,129 KiB | 3,313 KiB | 4,943 KiB | 3,758 KiB |

Mobile results are compared with mobile results and desktop with desktop. Audit dates and testing conditions differ. These are Lighthouse laboratory scores, not guaranteed real-user loading times. Core Web Vitals field assessments are separate from Lighthouse scores.
